_comment: Tier registry. Source of truth for model routing and rotation.
'rotation' is the pool the dispatcher actually cycles through for a tier.
'unverified' models exist in the catalog but have no benchmark grounding for
agentic coding; they are excluded from rotation unless --include-unverified is
passed. This keeps guessed placements from silently doing real work.
Benchmark figures are SWE-bench (Pro / Verified) as of 2026-08, directional only.

1.use: Docs, comments, copy, formatting, boilerplate. No logic changes.

rotation.note: Older generation of the benchmarked glm-5.2.

2.use: Typical fixes and small features. 1-3 files, no architectural decisions.

rotation.note: Briefly led open-weights on SWE-bench Pro. Arguably tier 3.

3.use: Multi-file refactors, security/financial logic, or tasks tier 2 already failed.

reviewer.use: Read-only second-model review of a completed diff.
reviewer._note: The dispatcher never picks a reviewer model equal to the implementer's model — a fresh prior is the entire point of this role.

oneshot.use: Pure text transformation, no tool loop.
